name: Qencode
description:
Transcoding & streaming — Convert to MP4/WebM, create adaptive HLS/DASH streams, repack containers or add/remove quality levels without re-encoding, and reduce bandwidth with per-title encoding and modern codecs (AV1, HEVC, VP9).

Editing — Trim, stitch, resize, crop, rotate, deinterlace, adjust frame rate or aspect ratio, convert HDR to SDR, remap audio, add watermarks, and manage subtitles or 360°/VR video.

Audio & images — Extract audio (MP3, M4A, FLAC, audio-only HLS), generate thumbnails and sprite sheets with WebVTT seek previews, create GIFs, and let AI pick the best frame.

AI intelligence — Describe, moderate, and search video; ask custom questions; transcribe with speaker labels and timestamps; export and translate subtitles (15 languages); detect AI-generated video; score quality with VMAF; read metadata.

Security — AES-128 encryption, DRM (Widevine, FairPlay, PlayReady), and forensic watermarking.

Storage & delivery — Send outputs to AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze, or FTP — multiple destinations per job — plus buckets, time-limited links, URL imports, and temp storage.

Automation — Start jobs from URLs, S3, or uploads; produce multiple outputs in one job (HLS + MP4 + thumbnails + transcript); track progress; get webhooks on completion with auto-retry; and use built-in recipes so AI agents build correct jobs on the first try.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Qencode to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Qencode to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.qencode.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Qencode MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Qencode provides these MCP tools: fetch_qencode_doc, get_job_status, search_qencode_docs, start_encode2_raw, transcode_video, wait_for_job, list_buckets, create_bucket, list_objects, get_download_url, and download_url_to_bucket.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Qencode?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Qencode in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Qencode requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Qencode is developed by Qencode Corp.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
